# University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences

> > USAHS offers graduate healthcare degree programs in physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, and nursing across multiple campuses with flexible online, hybrid, and residential formats.

University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences (USAHS) is a B Corp certified graduate institution specializing in health sciences education with over 10,000 alumni. The university operates multiple campuses including Austin TX, San Marcos CA, Dallas TX, St. Augustine FL, and Miami FL, offering entry-level and post-professional degrees designed for working professionals.

## Key Topics

- Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT)
- Master of Occupational Therapy (MOT)
- Doctor of Occupational Therapy (OTD)
- Master of Science in Speech-Language Pathology (MS-SLP)
- College of Rehabilitative Sciences
- Clinical training
- Online and hybrid formats
- Multi-campus locations
- Graduate admissions
- Post-professional programs
- Orthopaedic residency specialization
- Healthcare education
- Alumni network
- B Corp certification

## Graduate Degree Programs

- [University of St. Augustine: Health Sciences Graduate School Programs](https://www.usa.edu): USAHS homepage showcasing graduate programs in PT, OT, SLP, nursing across multiple campuses.
- [Graduate Healthcare Degree Programs | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/degree-programs): Directory of all graduate degree programs across multiple campuses and formats.
- [Apply now | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/apply-now): Application portal for DPT, MOT, OTD, and MS-SLP healthcare degree programs.

## Physical Therapy Programs

- [Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) Degree Program | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/doctor-physical-therapy): DPT degree program with multiple campuses, formats, and accelerated options.
- [Physical Therapy Programs | USAHS Rehabilitative Sciences](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/physical-therapy-programs): PT program overview including DPT and orthopaedic residency specializations.
- [Clinical Orthopaedic Residency for Physical Therapy (OCS) | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/clinical-orthopaedic-residency): Post-graduate OCS orthopaedic residency for practicing physical therapists.
- [Non-Degree Online Physical Therapy Courses for International Students | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/physical-therapy-online-courses-international-students): Non-degree PT courses for foreign-trained therapists, not a DPT pathway.

## Occupational Therapy Programs

- [Occupational Therapy (OT) Degree Programs | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/programs/occupational-therapy-programs): OT program overview comparing MOT and OTD degree options with admissions details.
- [Master of Occupational Therapy (MOT) Degree Program | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/master-of-occupational-therapy-mot): MOT degree program details including formats, tuition, and clinical training.
- [Doctor of Occupational Therapy Program (OTD Degree) | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/doctor-occupational-therapy): OTD degree program combining online study with hands-on clinical practice.
- [Post-Professional Doctor of Occupational Therapy (PPOTD) | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/post-professional-doctor-occupational-therapy-pp-otd): PPOTD online program for career advancement of licensed occupational therapists.

## Speech-Language Pathology Programs

- [Speech-Language Pathology | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/speech-language-pathology-program): SLP program overview featuring MS-SLP degree with blended learning and clinical training.
- [Master of Science in Speech-Language Pathology | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/master-science-speech-language-pathology-ms-slp): MS-SLP online hybrid program preparing students for speech-language pathology licensure.
- [SLP Leveling Courses | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences/master-science-speech-language-pathology-ms-slp/leveling-courses): Six online prerequisite leveling courses for MS-SLP program qualification.

## Colleges & Academic Structure

- [College of Rehabilitative Sciences: Graduate Programs](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-rehabilitative-sciences): College overview for PT, OT, SLP programs with entry-level and post-professional options.
- [College of Health Sciences: Graduate Degree Programs | USAHS](https://www.usa.edu/college-of-health-sciences): College overview for nursing, health administration, and nurse practitioner degrees.

## Community & Career Resources

- [USAHS Alumni | USA for Health Sciences](https://www.usa.edu/about/usahs-alumni): Alumni network with 10,000+ graduates, membership benefits, and career services.
- [Working at University of St. Augustine](https://careers.usa.edu): Job openings and career opportunities at USAHS, B Corp certified employer.
